hypothesis: All publisher-labeled same-event and deterministically sampled different-event pairs collapse to one non-discriminating structural basis after Netbraid normalization, so the structural v0 reducer selects unknown for every weighted pair.

normalization.label_join: observer plus exact Frame_number equals packet frame.number

negative_population.candidate_construction: for each lexicographic observer pair, sort each side by oracle key then frame number; pair the first min(side counts) left rows with a cyclically offset permutation of right rows; reject equal oracle keys
negative_population.offset: 1 + first eight bytes of SHA-256(campaign_id + observer_pair), modulo right-side row count
negative_population.selection: rank unique candidates by SHA-256(campaign_id + canonical observer/frame ids), then take the first expected_count

pairs.representative_reduction: group each labeled population by the exact eligibility and allowed comparative values for both canonically ordered packets; run the Rust reducer once on the lexicographically first pair per label and basis; apply the group count as its weight

primary: weighted disposition counts by oracle label
distinct structural pair-basis count by oracle label
diagnostic: normalized packet and quarantine counts by observer
metrics.classification_accuracy: not_reported because abstention is an explicit retained outcome and the campaign is a capability boundary audit

failure_gates: archive identity or selected member inventory differs
normalization is partial, quarantined, or not bijective with publisher labels
pair populations differ from registered counts
any reducer assessment uses a basis outside the closed allowlist
observed weighted dispositions or basis counts differ from expected_results
two executions at the same revision produce different report bytes

interpretation.if_confirmed: This Sorbonne run validates the abstention boundary and pipeline wiring but cannot estimate same-event discrimination; a richer corpus is required.
interpretation.if_falsified: Stop and inspect normalization, label joins, or newly varying structural evidence before changing the reducer or campaign.

limitations: publisher keys label event correspondence but are never reducer inputs
the prior oracle audit already established constant publisher invariant metadata, so this is a confirmatory contract campaign rather than a discovery claim
deterministic negative sampling measures this registered population only
source authenticity and annotation correctness are not independently established
